name: PerfArena's 99 LeetCode problems
description: The curated set this platform was built around: the 99 longest-runtime, discriminative-distribution LeetCode problems (33 per difficulty) selected via the mode-share and runtime-spread filters documented in `docs/problem-selection.md`.

name: CLBG — 10 energy benchmarks
description: The 10 Computer Language Benchmarks Game problems used by the greensoftwarelab/Energy-Languages harness. Each submission is scored by the arena-local harness on wall-clock runtime, peak RSS, and package-domain energy (RAPL on Linux; CodeCarbon/powermetrics on macOS). Unlike LeetCode competitions, there are no test-case inputs — every problem has one canonical N (`default_argument`) at which measurement runs, and a small `validation_n` where output is diff'd against a reference file for correctness.

name: LeetCode 99 Hard (rewritten)
description: Anti-contamination variant of `leetcode-99-hard-perf` — same task set, rephrased statements and function names. Submissions are transparently routed to the original problems on LeetCode at dispatch time.

name: LeetCode 99 Hard Problems
description: 99 Hard LeetCode problems with the longest median accepted Python runtime, selected from data/runtime_ranking.json. Picked for runtime-discrimination — the median p50_ms ranges from ~418 ms to ~5451 ms, where small differences in algorithmic quality are big enough to read above LeetCode's per-run timing noise.
